prompts.meadow-albedo.png: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production game environment ground ALBEDO texture, NOT an illustration or screenshot. Rich realistic scanned-material detail comparable to premium photogrammetry terrain textures used in Unreal Engine 5. Fully flat neutral diffuse lighting, no directional shadows, no ambient occlusion baked in, no highlights, no perspective, no horizon, no visible light sources, no decorative flowers, no large rocks, no border, no text.
